decisions.reason: The illuminated candle arch builds directly on the firm's arch-making craft, so management can interpret early results and refine the product, and its home-page placement signals commitment.
A one-tier Christmas pyramid is core to the firm's established knowledge base, so absorptive capacity is high and the product fits existing workshop skills.

The electronic music box with interchangeable discs lies far from the firm's woodcraft knowledge and the firm lacks R&D, but its home-page prominence and the firm's existing music box line give it partial grounding for at least another year.
The motif platform for the electronic music box is distant from the firm's knowledge and only mentioned on the site, so without in-house R&D the firm can hardly learn from its results.
This Christmas motif platform is a peripheral accessory in an unfamiliar electronic domain with low visibility, so limited related knowledge makes discontinuation likely.
A Dresden-themed Christmas pyramid extends the firm's core pyramid craftsmanship, allowing it to assimilate market feedback and improve the piece.
